title: Mashhad- Monday, September 14th - Sepehran Airlines Boeing 737 Makes Emergency Landing in Mashhad
text:
Mashhad- Monday, September 14th - Sepehran Airlines Boeing 737 Makes Emergency Landing in Mashhad"

"A Sepehran Airlines Boeing 737 operating a Mashhad–Kermanshah flight experienced a problem with one of its tires and possible engine damage shortly after takeoff."

"The pilot declared an emergency and returned the aircraft to Mashhad Airport, where it landed safely."

"Following the incident, Runway 31L at Mashhad Airport was temporarily closed. Some inbound and outbound flights may be delayed or rescheduled.
